backend: QEMU NVMe Ctrl, serial ESTUS-LAB-NVME, /dev/nvme0 with guest-only /dev/nvme0n1
raw_capture: nvme smart-log /dev/nvme0 --raw-binary; exactly 512 genuine bytes stored as lowercase hexadecimal
preparation: dd if=/dev/zero of=/dev/nvme0n1 bs=4096 count=256 oflag=direct conv=fsync; dd if=/dev/nvme0n1 of=/dev/null bs=4096 count=256 iflag=direct
expected: Actual successful MCP typed telemetry projections; only controller identity/state/scope/source and collection timestamp excluded from pure SMART-parser expectations
observed_change: host_read_commands 83 to 412; host_write_commands 0 to 256; data_units_read 4 to 9; data_units_written 0 to 3
scope: Virtual/reported controller telemetry only. Warning0, Kelvin323, spare0 and use0 are actual device reports, not physical-media guarantees or invented healthy status.
sanitization: No media payloads, host device data, keys, credentials or physical serials captured; controlled lab serial only
